title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Pamplona 市镇 Cagbibi 描笼涯的 San Gabriel附属校分离，改设为独立的 Cagbibi 国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School - Cagbibi Annex in Barangay Cagbibi, Municipality of Pamplona, Province of Camarines Sur From the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Cagbibi National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School - Cagbibi Annex in Barangay Cagbibi, Municipality of Pamplona, Province of Camarines Sur From the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Cagbibi National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Cagbibi của Trường Trung học San Gabriel-San Isidro Quốc gia tại Barangay Cagbibi, Đô thị Pamplona, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học San Gabriel-San Isidro Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Cagbibi Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Cagbibi ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Gabriel-San Isidro แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cagbibi เทศบาล Pamplona จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Gabriel-San Isidro แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cagbibi แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Cagbibi, Sekolah Menengah San Gabriel-San Isidro Nasional di Barangay Cagbibi, Kotamadya Pamplona, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah San Gabriel-San Isidro Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cagbibi Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Cagbibi, Sekolah Menengah San Gabriel-San Isidro Kebangsaan di Barangay Cagbibi, Perbandaran Pamplona, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah San Gabriel-San Isidro Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Cagbibi Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School – Cagbibi Annex in Barangay Cagbibi, Municipality of Pamplona, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Cagbibi National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School – Cagbibi Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cagbibi National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Cagbibi National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the San Gabriel-San Isidro National High School – Cagbibi Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
